enrichment.summary: Aquaservice AS is a Norwegian manufacturer of HDPE-based water-handling equipment for aquaculture and maritime industries, operating a 12,000 m² engineering and production facility in Straumgjerde, Sykkylven (f4, f9). Its product range spans self-cleaning industrial pressure filters, the design-protected Aquatrans three-way fish-transport valve, UV plants, pool treatment systems, sea pipelines, certified service rafts and HardRIB boats (f9, f20, f23, f8). Founded in 1985, the company passed through Ocea/Steinsvik/ScaleAQ ownership before key personnel bought it back in 2021, and it is now expanding internationally with units in the UK (2025) and Chile (2026) (f7, f3, f2, f5, f6).
